data.long_meaning: Symbol of strength and support, representing the foundation of life. data.cultural_impact: The name Dharu holds great cultural significance in Hinduism, as it is the name of Lord Indra's weapon - the vajra or thunderbolt. In Hindu mythology, Lord Indra, the king of the heaven, wields this divine weapon to protect the gods and maintain balance in the universe. Dharu symbolizes power, strength, and the ability to restore balance and order in chaotic situations.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Dharu reminds us of the importance of a strong foundation and inner stability, which is essential for our personal growth and spiritual evolution. It invokes the earnest desire to be rooted in our values, beliefs, and the unwavering truth, allowing us to draw strength and courage during challenging times. The name Dharu also reflects the concept of 'Dharma', the greatest virtue and duty in Hinduism, which encourages us to live in harmony with our values and the natural order of the universe.
